user.title: Battery Plan
user.description: Plans battery charging and export against your Octopus tariff. Give this planner a name.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Pick your battery and Octopus Energy integration entities. Everything can be changed later under Configure.

data_description.capacity_kwh: Usable battery energy between 0 and 100% SOC.
data_description.target_soc: SOC the overnight charge aims for.
data_description.reserve_soc: Planned exports stop at this SOC; used outside the day window and at the start of the charge window.
data_description.min_soc: Battery stops discharging below this (e.g. Victron ESS minimum SoC); the house then runs from grid.
data_description.day_reserve_soc: Optional: a higher floor during the day (e.g. 25%), so daytime exports stop earlier.
data_description.day_reserve_end: When the night floor takes over again.

data_description.import_rates: Octopus Energy integration events, e.g. …_current_day_rates and …_next_day_rates (import meter).
data_description.export_rates: The same events for the export meter (Agile Outgoing). Leave empty if you don't export.
data_description.standing_charge_entity: Optional: daily standing charge (…_current_standing_charge), subtracted from daily net.

data_description.schedule_start_entity: Optional: your inverter's charge schedule start (e.g. Victron ESS schedule start). When set, it overrides the window start below.
data_description.schedule_duration_entity: Optional: the schedule's duration (minutes unless the entity says otherwise). Overrides the window length below.
data_description.schedule_soc_entity: Optional: the schedule's target SOC. Overrides the charge target.
data_description.consumed_ah_entity: Optional: battery monitor consumed Ah. Spread charging then sizes the current from the BMS capacity (consumed Ah ÷ (100 − SOC)), like the Node-RED spreader.
data_description.charge_window_from_rates: Use the import rates' daily off-peak period as the charge window (e.g. 23:30-05:30 on Intelligent Octopus Go), ignoring dispatches. Overrides the schedule entities and the start and length below, which still apply when no off-peak period is found (e.g. Agile).
data_description.charge_start: Start of the cheap-rate grid-charge window.
data_description.charge_mode: Full power, or spread over the window to finish shortly before it ends.
data_description.max_charge_kw: Battery-side charge power at full rate.
data_description.min_charge_kw: Spread mode never charges slower than this.
data_description.makeup_kw: Spread mode adds this on top of the calculated rate.
data_description.finish_early_min: Spread mode aims to finish this long before the window ends.
data_description.finish_early_full_min: Used instead when the target is 100%, to allow time to balance.
data_description.long_balance_day: Optional: the night (window start day) that finishes even earlier.
data_description.charge_eff: Grid AC to battery, used for import energy and cost estimates.

data.export_peak_import: Buy at peak to export more
data.night_cycle: Buy, sell and buy back overnight
data.reject_dispatch: Reject a dispatch for an export
data.export_hold_minutes: Hold the export for the last

data_description.saving_export_kw: Optional: power during Octopus saving sessions (defaults to the maximum above).
data_description.inverter_max_kw: Optional: the inverter's maximum AC output, shared by the house load and export (e.g. 12.5 kW for a Quattro 15k). Each half hour's export is planned at no more than this less the house load (the setpoint still asks for the full amount).
data_description.export_margin: Export a kWh only when it earns at least this much more than keeping it would save (a smaller overnight recharge, house load not bought later, nothing ahead of a free session). Covers battery wear and forecast error; 4-5p is typical.
data_description.export_peak_import: Allow exports that leave the house buying at peak rate before the charge window, when the export still beats that by the margin. Bought afterwards first, then in advance.
data_description.buy_ahead_hours: How long before an export the house may run from grid, or the battery grid-charge, to export more. Nearest the export first; shorter means less is bought on a forecast.
data_description.night_cycle: May export inside the overnight charge window (down to the night floor) and charge it back before the window ends, when that beats the margin. The window then charges at full power (a spread charge leaves little time to buy back). To control it, the overnight charge must come from the charge schedule (see Control).
data_description.reject_dispatch: May export in an Intelligent Octopus dispatch outside the charge window (e.g. one in the evening peak) instead of topping up, when that beats keeping the dispatch by the margin. The EV charger is inhibited while exporting, so the car doesn't charge then and Octopus usually reschedules. Dispatches inside the overnight window are always kept (buy-sell-buy doesn't sell in them). Needs the EV allow switch to stop the car; with the charge schedule SOC set it isn't raised in that dispatch.
data_description.export_tracking: Control only: aim for the plan's SOC at the end of each export slot, adjusting for the live house load, instead of exporting a fixed power.
data_description.export_hold_minutes: Control only: in the last minutes of each half hour keep the export power as it is instead of tracking to the end (aiming at the end over a few minutes tapers off or surges). 0 tracks to the end.

data_description.load_entities: Optional: power sensors summed to learn an hourly load profile (e.g. AC loads L1–L3).
data_description.load_days: Days of statistics used for the load profile.
data_description.load_kw: Used when no load sensors are set, or for hours with no data.
data_description.load_exclude_entities: Optional: subtracted from the load, e.g. an EV charger that charges on cheap-rate grid power.
data_description.weather_entity: Optional: a weather entity with hourly forecasts. Turns on weather-dependent load: the house load is adjusted for the forecast temperature, learned from your own history.
data_description.outdoor_temp_entity: Optional: an outdoor temperature sensor to learn from. Without it, the weather entity's recorded temperature is used.
data_description.weather_load_entities: Optional: power sensors for heating or cooling (e.g. heat pump input power). Without them, the effect is learned from the whole-house load. Leave out hot water if it runs off-peak.
data_description.weather_cooling: Also learn extra load in hot weather (air conditioning).
data_description.weather_days: How many days of history to learn the temperature effect from.

data_description.dispatching_entity: Optional: …_intelligent_dispatching binary sensor; its planned dispatches are added to the plan.
data_description.dispatch_charges_battery: Treat dispatches outside the charge window as full-rate battery top-ups.
data_description.target_time_entity: Optional: …_intelligent_target_time select/time entity, for the dispatch-hours sensors.
data_description.free_calendar: Optional: Octoplus free electricity sessions calendar (capped, see below).
data_description.free_cap_kwh: Free electricity is capped at this much import per session (house and car included; 0 = no cap). Past it the battery stops charging at peak, but carries on where import is off-peak anyway (an IOG dispatch).
data_description.power_up_calendar: Optional: Octoplus Power Up calendar. Free like a free electricity session, with no cap.

data_description.use_energy_costs: Take actual import cost and export earnings from the Energy dashboard's grid cost statistics, so they match it. Falls back to the grid power sensor below.
data_description.grid_power_entity: Optional: grid power (import positive). Used for actual costs when the Energy dashboard has no grid costs, and for the Battery action sensor.
data_description.grid_power_invert: Turn on if your sensor reports export as positive.
data_description.battery_power_entity: Optional: battery power (charging positive). Makes the Battery action sensor more accurate.
data_description.battery_power_invert: Turn on if your sensor reports discharging as positive.

data.charge_schedule_window: Charge overnight with the charge schedule

data_description.grid_setpoint_entity: Optional: number entity for the grid setpoint (e.g. Victron ESS AC power setpoint). Adds a 'Grid setpoint control' switch.
data_description.charge_current_entity: Optional: number entity for the charge current limit (e.g. Victron DVCC max charge current). Adds a 'Charge current control' switch.
data_description.charge_schedule_soc_entity: Optional: target SOC of a charge schedule left on all day (e.g. Victron ESS schedule 5). Written with the charge current: raised for IOG dispatches, free sessions and charges bought ahead of an export, parked otherwise. Turn off anything else that switches this schedule.
data_description.charge_schedule_idle_soc: Target SOC when no charge is wanted; below the battery's SOC so the schedule has no effect.
data_description.charge_schedule_window: Also raise the charge schedule for the overnight window (parked only while the plan exports in it), for setups without a separate overnight schedule. Needed for buy, sell and buy back.
data_description.idle_setpoint_w: Setpoint when not exporting or charging (e.g. -50 W), and the fallback value.
data_description.charge_setpoint_w: Setpoint during charge, hold and IOG slots.
data_description.setpoint_deadband_w: Changes smaller than this are not written.
data_description.current_deadband_a: Charge current changes smaller than this are not written (fewer writes to the GX; a current a little high just finishes the charge a little early).
data_description.battery_voltage: Nominal voltage to convert charge power to current.
data_description.stale_minutes: If the plan is older than this, control falls back to the idle setpoint.
data_description.heartbeat_topic: Optional: publishes "on" every 30 s while controlling and "off" when stopped, for a watchdog (e.g. in Node-RED).
data_description.ev_allow_entity: Optional: switch turned off while exporting outside the charge window and on otherwise (e.g. a GX relay wired to a Zappi eSense input). Only written while Control is on.
data_description.ev_allow_invert: Turn on if the switch must be ON to pause charging.

error.reserve_above_target: The export floor must be below the charge target.
error.min_above_reserve: Minimum SOC must not be above the export floor.
error.min_charge_above_max: Minimum charge power must not exceed the maximum.
